stage0014_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Training with the petit mobiles really is fun.
　Though it's tiring.」

stage0014_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Unlike classroom lectures, you really feel
　just how vast space is.」

stage0014_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミコット$$
「$$沙慈$$, you're really something, you know.
　You handle sudden trouble so fast.」

stage0014_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$沙慈$$
「I've got to work harder, since I'm older
　than all of you.」

stage0014_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Right, right!
　And all for his beloved $$ルイス$$!」

stage0014_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ハロ$$
「Something wrong, $$バナージ$$? Something wrong, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0014_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Even $$ハロ$$'s worried about you.」

stage0014_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Hey, $$バナージ$$... you know...」

stage0014_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Sometimes you get this far-off look
　on your face.」

stage0014_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That's probably... not me looking at anything...
　I think it's when I'm wondering where I am.」

stage0014_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Is that about your dad? The one who
　never saw you after your mom passed, yet
　still got you into Anaheim Tech?」

stage0014_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Like whatever I'm doing,
　I'm never really living in that moment...」

stage0014_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ミコット$$
「I feel that too, then.
　Like something's out of sync, right?」

stage0014_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$沙慈$$
「But the moment that feeling of being
　out of sync clicks into place comes suddenly.」

stage0014_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$沙慈$$
「It's strange, isn't it...
　That there's a $$ハロ$$ in the $$ＵＣＷ$$ too.」

stage0014_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$バナージ$$
「There's one in the $$ＡＤＷ$$ too?」

stage0014_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$沙慈$$
「...Yeah. Maybe $$ハロ$$'s like the Gundams...
　something that exists in common
　across parallel worlds.」

stage0014_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ミコット$$
「What's it like, when that feeling
　of being out of sync goes away?」

stage0014_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Hard to put into words, but...
　it's like the moment fate starts moving.」

stage0014_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Heh... for you, $$沙慈$$, does that mean
　meeting $$ルイス$$ was fate?」

stage0014_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「A meeting ordained by fate... huh...」

stage0014_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$バナージ$$
（That's not like that feeling on Earth...
　But someone's calling...!）

stage0014_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Communications Room

stage0014_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Communications Room

stage0014_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Communications Room

stage0014_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, Communications Room ～

stage0014_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「...That's the new orders handed down to you all.」

stage0014_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「This means the Echoes aboard this ship now
　answer to a chain of command independent of Londo Bell.
　Think of this ship as something like a taxi.」

stage0014_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$コンロイ$$
（Anaheim's reach even extends to Echoes HQ...）

stage0014_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ダグザ$$
（This man $$アルベルト$$...
　what is he planning to do at Industrial 7...）

stage0014_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「For the time being, you'll all cooperate with me.」

stage0014_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Are you telling us to stage a coup
　and seize control of this ship?」

stage0014_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I've no such thing in mind.
　I intend to rely on this ship's strength as well.」

stage0014_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Once we approach Industrial 7, you'll act
　separately from the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, together with me.」

stage0014_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I'll handle the report to Captain $$オットー$$ myself.
　You need not worry, just follow my orders.」

stage0014_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Looks like you're okay for now...
　Are you hurt?」

stage0014_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Isn't that a bit much?
　I'm the one who just saved you.」

stage0014_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But you sure surprised me.
　A person falling out of the colony shaft...」

stage0014_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Good thing I noticed and caught you
　with the 《$$トロハチ$$》, or you'd have
　hit the ground and died sooner or later.」

stage0014_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Though thanks to pushing it too hard,
　the $$トロハチ$$ broke on landing.」

stage0014_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
???
「...Do you live in this colony? I'm in a hurry.
　Could you take me to the entrance
　of the Colony Builder?」

stage0014_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
???
「There's no time! Please!
　There's someone I have to meet and talk to!」

stage0014_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
???
「If I don't hurry, it'll be too late to fix!
　It can still be stopped, if it's now! So...!」

stage0014_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Who is it you want to see?」

stage0014_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$カタツムリ$$... That's what everyone calls
　the Colony Builder, but that place
　is just a factory.」

stage0014_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I've heard rumors there's a Vist Foundation
　mansion deep inside, but...」

stage0014_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$バナージ$$
「No, I've never seen it myself...
　but a Foundation bigwig chairs my school.」

stage0014_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Once we're through here, it's not much farther.」

stage0014_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
???
「Is that a construction unit moving over there...?」

stage0014_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Yeah, a work unit that builds ground blocks.
　This colony's still under construction.」

stage0014_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Here, eat this hot dog.
　You're hungry, right?」

stage0014_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I never imagined you'd stow away
　like this.」

stage0014_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Let's go back.
　Please consider your position...」

stage0014_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
???
「It's precisely because I considered
　my position that I came here.」

stage0014_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Please, stop this pointless act.」

stage0014_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
???
「We can't make proper use of Laplace's Box
　as we are now. He agrees with that too.」

stage0014_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
???
「It's whoever tries to use it who's dangerous.
　In this new world too, it would only become
　a spark for pointless conflict.」

stage0014_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
???
「You, of all people, should understand, right?」

stage0014_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「...I don't understand.
　I only follow orders.」

stage0014_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
???
「Liar! The power given to you was never
　meant for something like this...!」

stage0014_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ハロ$$! Hold that woman back!」

stage0014_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ハロ$$
「Leave it to me, $$バナージ$$! Leave it to me, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0014_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「You dare stand in my way, boy!」

stage0014_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Now's our chance! Come with me!」

stage0014_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「This is an emergency, $$マリーダ$$」

stage0014_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「No... you return to the $$ガランシェール$$.
　Things are getting noisy outside」

stage0014_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I can guess where she's headed.
　Leave that to me」

stage0014_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
???
「$$バナージ$$... you shouldn't just barge in...」

stage0014_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Did I... tell you my name?」

stage0014_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
???
「Because this little one kept saying it...」

stage0014_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This is $$ハロ$$.
　Never heard of it? A mascot robot replica
　made by an ace pilot during the war」

stage0014_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I... used to live out in the country」

stage0014_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Or rather, I'm a drifter.
　That's just how I was born」

stage0014_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Who was that person chasing you?」

stage0014_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$オードリー$$
「One of my own.
　I ran away from them...」

stage0014_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$バナージ$$
「An activist or something?
　That... anti-Federation, Spacenoid autonomy,
　that kind of thing...」

stage0014_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Maybe...
　But it might be scarier than that」

stage0014_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You said you wanted to stop the war...」

stage0014_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$オードリー$$
「This tapestry on the wall... a unicorn.
　There's some writing on it,
　looks like an old language from somewhere...」

stage0014_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...My... one and only wish...」

stage0014_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What is this...
　Have I... been here before...?」

stage0014_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I've... seen this picture before...!?」

stage0014_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「The Lady and the Unicorn...
　A tapestry thought to have been made in France
　sometime before the Middle Ages」

stage0014_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
Cardeas
「My predecessor obtained it before the $$一年戦争$$.
　...I am the head of this house, $$カーディアス・ビスト$$」

stage0014_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Forgive my intrusion into your home, uninvited.
　I am...」

stage0014_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「I know who you are.
　It would be best not to speak that name now」

stage0014_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Then I won't give my name.
　As long as you understand my position, that's enough」

stage0014_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I came here hoping you'd reconsider.
　The matter of entrusting Laplace's Box to us」

stage0014_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「...It's dangerous.
　For me to meet with you like this」

stage0014_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Why is that?
　I've heard Laplace's Box was the lifeline
　that long assured the Vist Foundation's prosperity」

stage0014_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Then why give it to us?」

stage0014_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Are the words 'the world has changed'
　not enough to satisfy you?」

stage0014_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Then all the more reason.
　How much power it might hold in this new world,
　I couldn't say, but...」

stage0014_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$オードリー$$
「At least this much is clear...
　it will sow conflict」

stage0014_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Didn't I tell you to go home?」

stage0014_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$バナージ$$
「She's being chased!
　I can't leave her alone!」

stage0014_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Why is this person being chased, and by whom...
　Do you know that?」

stage0014_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't know.
　But they're scary people」

stage0014_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That's just how it feels」

stage0014_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$カーディアス$$
（Just as I thought...）

stage0014_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「You speak like a Newtype」

stage0014_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「You'll throw your future away.
　That's likely not what the father who enrolled you
　at Anaheim's technical college truly wanted」

stage0014_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「How do you know that...?」

stage0014_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「I'm the chairman of that school's board.
　I can look into any student's records, and expel
　those with poor conduct」

stage0014_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$オードリー$$
「$$バナージ$$, go home」

stage0014_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you for bringing me this far.
　I can manage on my own from here」

stage0014_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$... I'll help you.
　You came to stop the war, didn't you?
　And he's someone with that kind of power, right?」

stage0014_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$バナージ$$
「When you say 'war,'
　it's not like hearing it from school or TV news...
　It weighs on me」

stage0014_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I understand it's something scary.
　That's why I... that's why!」

stage0014_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This morning, when I saw you falling from the sky,
　my heart was pounding so hard」

stage0014_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Something that felt out of place snapped back,
　and for the first time, I felt like I found my place」

stage0014_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't care who you really are.
　Just tell me you need me!
　And then, I...!」

stage0014_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$オードリー$$
「You'd best not get involved with me anymore」

stage0014_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「That was the right decision.
　When the time is right, I'll introduce you
　to the allies who came to make the trade」

stage0014_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「I understand your concern.
　But I believe that he, of all people,
　can master that power」

stage0014_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$オードリー$$
「...He doesn't seem interested in the box」

stage0014_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「That only raises my expectations further」

stage0014_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...」

stage0014_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「I've heard rumors about that man as well」

stage0014_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「But even if he manages to get the key,
　Laplace's Box won't open for the unqualified」

stage0014_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「It's been rigged that way.
　That thing is a wild horse」

stage0014_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Not Laplace's Box itself,
　but just the key, handed over to us in Neo Zeon?」

stage0014_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Are you dissatisfied, Captain $$ジンネマン$$?」

stage0014_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...It's less dissatisfaction than confusion.
　To begin with, we don't even know
　what this box even is」

stage0014_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$ＵＣＷ$$... no, in a world with a calendar called
　the $$宇宙世紀$$, they say it would topple
　the Federation if opened, Laplace's Box...」

stage0014_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「The Vist Foundation's glory came from hiding it away.
　That's as much as I've heard」

stage0014_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「And while I'm at it, let me add,
　in this multiverse, what meaning it could even have
　is beyond me」

stage0014_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Your doubts are reasonable, Captain」

stage0014_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「But I believe it's precisely in this new world
　that the box holds meaning」

stage0014_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Now I understand even less」

stage0014_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「At least your superiors acknowledged the box's worth.
　That's why they sent someone as skilled as you here」

stage0014_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I wonder about that...
　They might just want it as one more card
　to boost their own influence within the ranks」

stage0014_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「If it turns out to be poisoned after all,
　the top brass will be sorely disappointed.」

stage0014_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「...Captain, do you believe
　in the existence of Newtypes?」

stage0014_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「On the battlefield, I've felt a power
　that could only be explained that way...」

stage0014_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Seems you've lived long on the battlefield.」

stage0014_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I've fought since the《$$一年戦争$$》.
　Though a few years were in a Federation camp.」

stage0014_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「That word 'power', from before...
　Only one who has felt it firsthand would say that.」

stage0014_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Humanity, having advanced into space, awakens
　every latent power to adapt to that vast expanse,
　and understands others without misunderstanding...」

stage0014_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「The Newtype theory once advocated by Zeon Zum Deikun
　spoke of human evolution and endless promise as power.」

stage0014_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「And a power similar to that
　has been confirmed in the $$ＡＤＷ$$ as well as the $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

stage0014_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Those so-called Innovators, is it...」

stage0014_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「That's right.
　Though I hear that research has stalled
　because of the $$新世時空震動$$.」

stage0014_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「In that respect, the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s Newtype research
　has the edge on them.」

stage0014_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Though because of that, there were even
　mad scientists artificially enhancing
　only the Newtype's use as a weapon.」

stage0014_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I hear that sort of research
　was already underway back in the $$一年戦争$$.」

stage0014_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「The Newtype, hailed as humanity's new potential,
　instead drew Federation suspicion, fueling the
　oppression of Spacenoids, $$ＵＣＷ$$ space stayed tense.」

stage0014_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「But the Earth Federation had a powerful ally
　that promised them final victory.
　Do you see what that was?」

stage0014_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Indeed.
　The masses, wanting only results, grew tired
　of Newtypes, undefined, offering mere possibility.」

stage0014_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「The name 'Newtype' soon became synonymous
　with 'ace pilot', the furthest thing from Deikun's
　ideal of people who understand each other truly.」

stage0014_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Laplace's Box holds the power to change the future.
　...No, perhaps I should call it the power to reclaim
　the future that should have been...」

stage0014_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「However, it isn't something just anyone can wield.
　Used wrongly, it could bring about the world's ruin.」

stage0014_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「This isn't like some magic box out of a fairy
　tale... or something along those lines?」

stage0014_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Heh... It's not as if opening the box
　triggers a spacequake and ends the world.」

stage0014_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「But if a transformed people's mind
　wishes for ruin, the result would be much the same.」

stage0014_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「That's right.
　So no matter how the world may change,
　Laplace's Box will never lose its value.」

stage0014_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Since it holds that much power,
　you mean to hand over the key first, to test us?」

stage0014_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「If you people are small-minded ideologues
　who cling to just one single cause,
　the box will never reveal what's inside.」

stage0014_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「And what would that one thing be?」

stage0014_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「The resurgence of Zeon.」

stage0014_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ガエル$$
「...Word just came in.
　Fighting has broken out outside the colony.」

stage0014_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Nothing ventured, nothing gained...
　If recovering the box had gone well, I meant to
　overlook you secretly pulling Londo Bell's strings...」

stage0014_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Now that it's come to this,
　I can't afford to take my time anymore.」

stage0014_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「I have no part in the fighting outside.
　I'd like to say it's because your movements
　were noticed, but that's a moot argument.」

stage0014_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「So you refuse to admit you set us up?」

stage0014_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「And you can't bring yourself to trust me either?」

stage0014_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Give her back to us.
　My men tracked her here, I know she's here.」

stage0014_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「That was my intention from the start.
　She's being treated with every courtesy.」

stage0014_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Trusting people truly is difficult...
　A pity, my lord.」

stage0014_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ガエル$$
「That Neo Zeon man
　doesn't seem to be coming after us.」

stage0014_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「More than a box he doubts even exists,
　protecting her must matter more to him.」

stage0014_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「But it's a shame...
　To think the pact between the Vist family
　and the Federation was so fragile...」

stage0014_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ガエル$$
「Is this the result of the world changing...
　Or is it that matter we spoke of...?」

stage0014_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「What's certain is the Federation means to
　seize the whole box now and control it themselves.」

stage0014_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「...Though it was we who broke our word first,
　and tried to hand the box to him instead...
　to the one likely in Zeon by now.」

stage0014_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
???
「That story... why don't you tell me more?」

stage0014_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「You'd best not move carelessly.
　Federation special forces are already inside.」

stage0014_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Now it all makes sense.
　So $$マーサ$$ was behind the Federation's move.」

stage0014_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I'll leave that to your imagination.」

stage0014_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「You think you're using the military,
　but it's you who's being used...!」

stage0014_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Farewell, $$カーディアス・ビスト$$.」

stage0014_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Cover me, $$ガエル$$!
　We can't let the key fall to the Federation!」

stage0014_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$オードリー$$
（I slipped out during the confusion, but...
　what do I do from here...）

stage0014_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$オードリー$$
（A battle has begun outside...
　the $$ガランシェール$$ unit against the Federation...）

stage0014_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Stray fire from the battle outside is
　hitting the colony. Get to the port too.」

stage0014_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Go, unless you want to die!」

stage0014_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$沙慈$$
「$$タクヤ$$, $$ミコット$$!
　Look after her!」

stage0014_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$沙慈$$
「I'll guide the people around here out!
　Now go, quickly!」

stage0014_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Got it!
　You be careful too, $$沙慈$$!」

stage0014_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ミコット$$
（$$バナージ$$... where are you...?）

stage0014_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Damn it...!
　I was looking for $$オードリー$$, and ended up here...!」

stage0014_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But what is this Vist Foundation...?
　They even have mobile suits underground...」

stage0014_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Where is she...! Where's $$オードリー$$!?」

stage0014_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「...She should be alive...
　She's survived deadly straits before, many times...」

stage0014_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't tell me you left her behind...!?
　Being in the cockpit means you meant to
　flee alone in this mobile suit!?」

stage0014_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Even fleeing... I wouldn't last long...」

stage0014_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you, anyway!
　Talking so big all the time!
　You can't do anything at all!!」

stage0014_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$ went to see you
　to try to stop the war!
　Didn't you have the power to do it!?」

stage0014_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Industrial 7 is a total wreck now!
　Everyone had plans for tomorrow...
　plans for next week, too!」

stage0014_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$バナージ$$
「And they're dying...!
　That's no way for a person to die!」

stage0014_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「At least my mother...
　my mother's death was different!
　It was more solemn than that... at least!」

stage0014_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「People are not animals.
　A person's death must never be meaningless...
　Yet we adults have spilled too much blood in vain...」

stage0014_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Not only that, we devoured the Earth,
　and sought an outlet for it in space...」

stage0014_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Now, people must govern themselves, and
　reclaim dignity, to fulfill hope spun long ago...」

stage0014_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$バナージ$$
「With the possibility within us,
　show the world humanity's strength and kindness...」

stage0014_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Only humans possess a god...
　power to surpass now: possibility, our inner god...!」

stage0014_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Are you sure your resolve won't waver now?」

stage0014_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「What she carries is heavy indeed...
　To walk with her, you must be ready to bear
　this world's weight...! Even so...!」

stage0014_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't have confidence, or resolve...
　I just want her to need me...!」

stage0014_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Then... take this with you...!」

stage0014_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This is... this white mobile suit...!?」

stage0014_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Give me your hand.」

stage0014_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「I have registered your bio-data.
　This unit will now obey no one but you.」

stage0014_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「If the Unicorn judges you a worthy pilot,
　it will grant you power like no other...!
　It may even open the way to Laplace's Box...」

stage0014_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「The curse that has bound our Vist family
　for so long...
　But used well, it can bring light to this world...!」

stage0014_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Why do you know my mother's name...!?」

stage0014_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Anna didn't want you dragged into this curse...
　so she left me...!」

stage0014_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Anna will resent me... and so will you...!
　But still, go!」

stage0014_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Don't be afraid...
　Believe in your own possibilities, give it
　everything, and the way will open on its own...!」

stage0014_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$バナージ$$
「No way...! This is so one-sided, now of all times!」

stage0014_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$カーディアス$$
「Forgive me... I wanted... so much more time... with you...」

stage0014_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$カーディアス$$
（$$バナージ$$...
　My wish... has come true... Anna......）

stage0014_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Father... me... right now...! My own...!」

stage0014_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Words I heard when I was small...」

stage0014_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「My one and only wish... the beast of possibility...
　the symbol of hope... Father...」

stage0014_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Mother, I'm sorry...
　I'm going!」

stage0014_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シン$$, the Gundam pilot you recovered...
　who is it?」

stage0014_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$シン$$
「They were out cold, so
　I forced the cockpit open.」

stage0014_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$シン$$
「Just as I figured, it was a civilian.
　They were taken straight to the infirmary.」

stage0014_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$エマ$$
「It looks like Industrial 7
　took quite a bit of damage too.」

stage0014_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$エマ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ reported rescuing
　civilians adrift near the dock too.」

stage0014_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$シン$$
「What's going to happen to them?」

stage0014_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$エマ$$
「The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ has already left the colony
　to dodge Neo Zeon's pursuit...」

stage0014_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$エマ$$
「Getting them somewhere safe will have to
　wait until things settle down.」

stage0014_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Still, that was a close one.
　If you hadn't been there, Neo Zeon
　would've had a field day.」

stage0014_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$シン$$
「Though we still don't know
　what they wanted with Industrial 7.」

stage0014_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$シン$$
「We were on patrol nearby when we got
　word about Neo Zeon movements.
　We rushed over and found them there.」

stage0014_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「《$$ザフト$$》 moved on such shaky intel?」

stage0014_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$シン$$
「The tipster called himself
　'the nameless clown.'」

stage0014_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$n
「That Gundam pilot...
　they've infiltrated a terrorist group
　as an informant?」

stage0014_03:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$エマ$$
「But if that's the case, shouldn't they
　have reported it up the chain and
　sent a bigger unit?」

stage0014_03:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$カツ$$
「That's right.
　The patrol squad's practically wiped out.」

stage0014_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$シン$$
「...The mood in $$プラント$$ seems to be
　shifting toward backing Neo Zeon...」

stage0014_03:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$シン$$
「So I figured if I reported it to $$ザフト$$ HQ,
　they might just order me to look away.」

stage0014_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So that's what was going on...」

stage0014_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$シン$$
「$$ラクス$$, $$キラ$$, Luna, $$アスラン$$, they're all
　doing their best in $$プラント$$, but at this rate
　$$プラント$$ will end up going the same way as Neo Zeon...」

stage0014_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$シン・アスカ$$...
　what do you plan to do now?」

stage0014_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$シン$$
「I've already decided.
　If $$プラント$$ throws in with Neo Zeon,
　I'll stay aboard this ship and fight my own fight.」

stage0014_03:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$シン$$
「I don't look it, but I'm back in 《 $$ＦＡＩＴＨ$$ 》 now.
　I have the right to act on my own judgment.」

stage0014_03:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$シン$$
「My squad's all confirmed safe, so
　I can leave the reporting to them.」

stage0014_03:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So we're fighting alongside each other again.」

stage0014_03:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$シン$$
「Can't say I'm thrilled about it.」

stage0014_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$エマ$$
「Understood, $$シン$$.
　Now, come with me, I'll explain the situation
　to Captain $$オットー$$.」

stage0014_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$シン$$
「It's been since the $$多元戦争$$,
　but let's do this again, Lieutenant $$エマ$$.」

stage0014_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$n
「You're reunited with your best friend,
　but you don't look too happy about it.」

stage0014_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Not in a situation like this.」

stage0014_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$n
「Neo Zeon is turning to
　more direct action...」

stage0014_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yeah...
　A declaration of war might not be far off now...」

stage0014_03:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（And in the middle of it, what did today's
　battle mean...? What in the world
　happened at that Industrial 7...）

stage0014_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text: ～ Transport Ship $$ガランシェール$$, Bridge ～

stage0014_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「A disgrace, $$スベロア・ジンネマン$$.
　Failing to secure Laplace's Box,
　and unable to protect the Princess herself.」

stage0014_03:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「It was all unforeseen circumstances.
　All we can do now is wait quietly
　for word from the Princess.」

stage0014_03:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You mean to do nothing at all...!?」

stage0014_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$,
　you should learn how to address an ally.」

stage0014_03:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Lady $$ハマーン$$...!
　Why are you aboard the $$ガランシェール$$...!?」

stage0014_03:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I came looking for the Princess.
　Though in the end, I wasn't able
　to find her.」

stage0014_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you want to curse a failure, go ahead.
　It's the truth, after all.」

stage0014_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「The situation isn't good.
　The Londo Bell force that showed up at
　Industrial 7 has already begun moving.」

stage0014_03:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「It would be trouble if they join up
　with the main force. Tell them
　to request reinforcements.」

stage0014_03:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「...A well-trained dog, isn't he.」

stage0014_03:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「My apologies, my lady.
　We've made you clean up
　after our own mess...」

stage0014_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「It's fine.
　It was the Princess who disrupted your
　operation, and that falls on me as well.」

stage0014_03:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Besides, it's a good chance.
　Let's see how that man fights.」

stage0014_03:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「A new Gundam has appeared.
　There's no way that man would sit still.」

stage0014_03:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Not as long as he still calls
　himself the Red Comet.」

stage0014_03:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard, $n!
　You shot down $$ハマーン・カーン$$ herself!」

stage0014_03:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even so, it's a huge win!
　Your foe was $$ハマーン$$, the Iron Lady herself!」

stage0014_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, by the way, that word 'win' just now
　carries two meanings: beating a foe
　above you, and a beautiful woman.」

stage0014_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...At least say 'huh...' or something...
　otherwise I feel kind of lonely.」

stage0014_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, downing $$ハマーン・カーン$$
　made for quite a haul in Z Chips.
　The total... a whopping 200 Z!」

stage0014_03:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0014_03:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, you must be $$シン・アスカ$$.
　I've heard about you from $$カミーユ$$.」

stage0014_03:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$シン$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$...
　Good to meet you.」

stage0014_03:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my... you're not what $$カミーユ$$'s
　stories led me to picture.」

stage0014_03:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard you were like a bare blade,
　snapping at anyone who rubbed you
　the wrong way.」

stage0014_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Supposedly you even told a head of state,
　'Fine words are your specialty, huh!'」

stage0014_03:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$シン$$
「Come on, drop the old stories.」

stage0014_03:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sorry, Master $$シン$$.
　That story I said I heard from $$カミーユ$$...
　all of it was a lie.」

stage0014_03:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... just a senior member's little
　prank on the new recruit.」

stage0014_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though sadly that didn't land,
　I'll bring the same energy to my real job!
　Now then, back to business, business!」
